name: Lacustrine-Lament
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by asteroid belt proximity. Farther poleward, past tectonic rift valleys, the silence feels older than the soil.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
